scope: No gameplay-success percentage. CONDITIONAL prospective scopes do not repair absent enrollment, old entered/queued histories or prove saved-owner retirement.

released_source_expectation.review_method: Read official exact version tag via browser tool and inspect named restore/start/patch/ID-generation functions. No old PR63 source is treated as current binary authority.
released_source_expectation.source_mechanism: Root quest registrations enter s_forced. Restore finds their quest, derives phase fact IDs, and starts In1 only when the corresponding engine receipt is absent; it then records that receipt. Normal quest start records the same receipts. The new binding uses this standard mechanism, without an explicit forceStart setting.

shared_registration_engine_boundary.missing: A matching installed DLL method/address/PDB/reproducible-build mapping or direct native instruction proof for OnGameRestored/ForceStartNode dispatch under SHA C07DA66D…; official version/source and receipt identify expected behavior but do not by themselves prove exact binary method identity.
shared_registration_engine_boundary.live_only: Actual new-owner restore scheduling, private marker acquisition/release, queued saves and interruption/reload delivery need supported in-game fixtures.
shared_registration_engine_boundary.scope: Separate shared registration-engine boundary; not an additional original21 target contract or source graph error.
